steps: 1. Preserve the passing coherent bundle; do not repeat its repair. The implementation worker first updates P08/progress.md within 600 words, records current source/code/test hashes and identifies this task as source-disposition. Preserve historical dossiers, retained correction bytes, frozen corpus and all protected supervisor files.

2. Record the bounded evidence and assumption audit in the new v6 dossier. Question: which retained EU provisions support each required claim for the fixed reporting context? Baselines: the checked AASB bundle and retained primary EU texts. Pass requires correct document relationships, pinned support, explicit applicability and complete dependency coverage. Missing material authority vetoes readiness for admission; corrupt provenance or protected-file changes stop dependent work. Counts and quote matches are explanatory only. Record provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and status for each material reporting assumption.

3. Create docs/design/research/p08-v6/source-disposition.json referencing preserved v3–v5 records. For each relation, record exact RDF subject, predicate and object, source path/hash and classification. Classify 2025/572, 2025/768, 2025/1358, 2026/237, 2026/240 and 2026/593 as the evidenced citation/EEA-incorporation relationships, not amendments to 2023/1803. Inspect actual amending and correcting relationships separately, including the reporting-scope chain for 1606/2002.

4. Integrate the retained Portuguese correction with its exact metadata, primary HTML and extraction pins. Record corrections to recitals 7/9 and Article 2, and the absence of an Article 4 correction in that document. Resolve only this historical access dependency. Carry forward and verify the other scope amendments, Polish correction, native-language corrigenda and genuine amendment decisions against their retained anchors.

5. Build a claim-specific applicability matrix for recognition, classification, split/residual equity, measurement, effective interest, coupons, redemption, conversion and selected notes. Each row specifies paragraph/section, jurisdiction, edition, effective period, reporting assumption, affected event/note, dependent provision, decision and remaining uncertainty. Cover IAS 32 settlement/option eligibility, IFRS 9 scope and liability exceptions, embedded derivatives, reporting eligibility and no-early-adoption transitions. Distinguish publication, legal effect and mandatory application dates; do not exclude later documents solely by year.

6. Use retained evidence first. Only if a specific material claim requires missing primary text, make one official retrieval batch of at most six requests, each capped at 30 seconds, recording redirects/access outcomes and retained bytes. Do not repeat the Portuguese download or unchanged failed routes. If access is unavailable, record it once and continue independent dossier validation; unavailable text remains uninspected.

7. Implement the separate preparation validator in scripts/corporate_authority_eu_current.py and extend tests/test_accounting_p08.py. Require complete relationship/claim coverage, safe unique paths, matching hashes, anchored passages, explicit period/context decisions and precise unresolved dependencies. Keep admission_allowed=false throughout this task, even if the dossier becomes ready for admission review. Test the positive dossier and rejection of wrong-subject predicates, citation-as-amendment substitutions, omitted relevant corrections, stale pins, unsupported eligibility, contradictory early-adoption decisions and attempted admission.

8. Integrate the new disposition and its complete dependency pins through scripts/build_accounting_p08.py and scripts/check_accounting_p08.py without rewriting historical records or changing lifecycle arithmetic. Regenerate authority-and-methods.json and update result.md to distinguish current disposition from historical access failures. Preserve criteria 1/2/4 within their bounded scope, criterion 3 incomplete, unresolved US/ASBE comparisons and the wider methods queue. Record every changed source/code/test file.

9. Stop research and edits with at least 120 seconds remaining. Run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 python3 -B scripts/build_accounting_p08.py, then CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p08.py --check; the latter includes the required unittest suite. Save a bounded validation-report.json under p08-v6 with commands, hashes, checks, unresolved claims and a decision table. Check that current AASB cases remain unchanged and no EU lifecycle is admitted. Stop after dossier validation and return PARTIAL with exact remaining work for independent review; do not begin lifecycle implementation.
summary: Plan only the bounded v6 source-disposition repair. The coherent engineering bundle is passing and hash-consistent; the next deliverable must integrate retained authority evidence and validate applicability before EU lifecycle changes.
